metadata.purpose: Bane removes the barrier ward during combat under the current Battle rules even when damage is blocked; targeted ping consumes the barrier first, and protection changes retaliation damage. Do not infer that barrier blocks bane.
metadata.future_turn_difference: Turn 2 guard can kill our leader; turn 3 surviving bane attacker can win.

horizon: A turn ends with full Battle.step(end_turn), including next start effects and draw; no next-player decision after final boundary.

metadata.purpose: Ping the oldest barrier before allocating four damage across two wards; a blocked share is still consumed. Reversing spell order leaves the old ward alive. Board list is oldest first.
metadata.future_turn_difference: Turn 3 fresh own attacker reaches the leader only if the blockers have been cleared; turn 1 has no own attack.
